proposed_widenings.name: item_or_object_attachment_for_activation_phase
proposed_widenings.justification: The item already has an alter-item effect atom, but activation phases cannot honestly target the held weapon itself.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "While holding this weapon, you can take a Bonus Action to alter its form, turning it into a 6-inch rod ... or a 10-foot pole, or reverting it a Quarterstaff"

proposed_widenings.name: item_form_predicate_for_magic_item_parts
proposed_widenings.justification: Passive and triggered-reaction item parts can gate on holding or wearing, but not on the item's current form.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Acrobatic Assist (Quarterstaff and 10-Foot Pole Forms Only)" and "Attack Deflection (Quarterstaff Form Only)"

proposed_widenings.name: emit_light
proposed_widenings.justification: The surface has no effect atom for an item or creature emitting dim or bright light.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can cause it to emit green Dim Light out to 10 feet"

proposed_widenings.name: return_item_to_holder_after_attack
proposed_widenings.justification: The thrown-return rider needs item motion support after resolving a ranged attack.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand."

notes: Authored an honest subset containing only the unconditional +2 attack and damage bonuses while holding the item. Form-changing, form-gated properties, light emission, and the thrown-return rider remain omitted.
